name: Room Booking Logic
script:
if doc.status == "Check Out" and not doc.sales_invoice:
    settings = frappe.get_doc("Booking Settings", "Booking Settings")
    rate_plan = frappe.get_doc("Room Rate Plan", doc.room_rate_plan)

    if doc.calculation_type == "Hourly":
        hours = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_hours(doc.check_out, doc.check_in)
        qty = int(hours) + (1 if hours % 1 > 0 else 0)
        rate = rate_plan.hourly_rate
    else:
        nights = (frappe.utils.getdate(doc.check_out) - frappe.utils.getdate(doc.check_in)).days
        qty = max(nights, 1)
        rate = rate_plan.daily_rate

    si = frappe.new_doc("Sales Invoice")
    si.customer = doc.customer
    si.company = doc.company
    si.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    si.update_stock = 1

    si.append("items", {
        "item_code": settings.accommodation_item,
        "qty": qty,
        "rate": rate
    })

    for row in doc.services:
        si.append("items", {
            "item_code": row.service,
            "qty": row.qty,
            "rate": row.rate
        })

    for row in doc.items:
        si.append("items", {
            "item_code": row.item,
            "qty": row.qty,
            "rate": row.rate,
            "warehouse": settings.default_warehouse
        })

    si.set_missing_values()
    si.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    si.submit()

    doc.db_set("sales_invoice", si.name)

name: Room Booking Conflicts
script:
if doc.room and doc.check_in and doc.check_out:
    conflicting = frappe.db.sql("""
        select name
        from `tabRoom Booking`
        where room = %(room)s
            and name != %(name)s
            and docstatus < 2
            and check_in < %(check_out)s
            and check_out > %(check_in)s
        limit 1
    """, {
        "room": doc.room,
        "name": doc.name or "New Room Booking",
        "check_in": doc.check_in,
        "check_out": doc.check_out,
    })

    if conflicting:
        frappe.throw(f"Комната {doc.room} уже забронирована на этот период (конфликт с {conflicting[0][0]})")
